sql: SELECT @@session.enable_file_sql
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv')
SET SESSION enable_file_sql=ON
SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(value),AVG(value),MIN(value),MAX(value) FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv')
SELECT l.id,l.name,r.label FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv') l INNER JOIN read_ndjson('{data}/right.jsonl') r ON l.id=r.id ORDER BY l.id
SELECT l.id,r.label FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv') l LEFT JOIN read_json('{data}/right.jsonl') r ON l.id=r.id ORDER BY l.id
SELECT value,COUNT(*) n FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv') GROUP BY value HAVING COUNT(*)=1 ORDER BY value LIMIT 2
DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv')
COPY (SELECT id,name FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv') ORDER BY id) TO '{data}/export.csv' (FORMAT csv, HEADER, NULLSTR 'NULL')
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{data}/export.csv') ORDER BY id
SELECT j.id,j.name FROM JSON_TABLE('[{"id":1,"name":"a"},{"id":2,"name":"longer"}]','$[*]' COLUMNS(id INT PATH '$.id',name VARCHAR(30) PATH '$.name')) j ORDER BY id
SELECT 2+3, UPPER('abc')
SELECT * FROM read_json('{data}/nested.jsonl')
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{data}/bad.csv')
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{data}/left.csv',sample_size=1)
SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(id),SUM(value),COUNT(value) FROM read_csv('{data}/batch.csv')
SELECT id,CONCAT(label,'!'),value+1 FROM read_csv('{data}/batch.csv') WHERE id IN (0,255,256,511,512,1023,1024,2047,2048,2052) ORDER BY id
COPY (SELECT 99 AS id) TO '{data}/export.csv' (FORMAT csv, HEADER)
SELECT * FROM read_csv('{data}/export.csv') ORDER BY id
COPY (SELECT * FROM read_csv('{data}/bad.csv')) TO '{data}/must_not_exist.csv' (FORMAT csv, HEADER)
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(file,'/',-1) FROM glob('{data}/export*.csv')
SELECT c1 FROM read_parquet('{data}/simple.parquet') ORDER BY c1
SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(c1) FROM read_parquet('{data}/simple.parquet')
SELECT p.c1,c.value FROM read_parquet('{data}/simple.parquet') p JOIN read_csv('{data}/left.csv') c ON p.c1=c.id ORDER BY p.c1
SELECT label FROM read_parquet('{data}/multigroup.parquet') WHERE id IN (0,1,3,4,6,7) ORDER BY id
